title: quivive tile data
description: Data for the bundled `quivive` tile: the fleet-presence status bar for one or more repositories that quivive watches. The tile is DATA-DRIVEN — waybar always references `quivive`, and the template renders by what you send: a header driven by the overall `status`, one compact row per entry in `repos[]`, and an attention line per attention item any repo carries. Feed it as `quivive tile --stream`'s stdout (JSON) or, one-shot, `quivive tile`. Each property notes REAL (quivive computed it from the ledger: leases, activity records, the events tail, plan.json, the beads sidecar) vs MOCK (a sample invented it; quivive's own emission of that field is not yet settled — see the README's divergence note).

v.description: REAL. The tile contract version. Moves only on a breaking change (S12/S13 of docs/spec.md in the quivive repo); a consumer ignores fields it doesn't know.

at.description: REAL. RFC 3339, UTC. The clock this tick was computed against — not "now" at read time, and read exactly once for the whole payload. Not currently used by this tile's template (the header renders from `status` alone), so it is not `required` here, but every real `quivive tile` payload carries it.

status.description: REAL. The overall status across every watched repo — one of quivive's five S8 states, in the same precedence order S8 derives per-repo status: human-needed (any repo has an attention item) beats active (any repo has a live agent) beats drained (a plan or recent fleet evidence exists somewhere but nothing is live) beats all-quiet (pact state exists but nothing is moving) beats no-fleet (no pact state anywhere). Drives the tile's accent icon/color and whether it pulses.

repos.description: REAL. One entry per repository quivive's tick read this cycle, in registry order.

name.description: REAL. The repo's directory basename — what a bar has room to print. Reconciled against quivive's real emitter by the golden tests in both repos (quivive-jx3); previously invented per sample, see the README's former divergence note.

path.description: REAL. The full, canonicalized path — what a human needs when two checkouts share a `name`. Not rendered by this tile's template today (no row has room for it), but part of the real payload and kept in the samples for byte-for-byte fidelity with quivive-jx3's goldens.

status.description: REAL. This repo's own S8 status (RepoAssessment.status).

agents.description: REAL. Counts over this repo's remembered agents, one bucket per state of the four-state machine (S7: ACTIVE/IDLE/STALE/DEAD). Always all four keys, zeros included.

attention.description: REAL. This repo's attention items (RepoAssessment.attention, S16-S18), already sorted and deterministic. Empty when the repo is not human-needed.

attentionItem.comment: Tagged union on `kind` (serde tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case"), mirroring quivive's AttentionItem exactly — see the state seam (src/state.rs) in the quivive repo. FleetDrained (S19) is deliberately absent: it's a transition event for `quivive watch`, not a per-repo attention item.

agent.description: REAL. The dead (or unknown) holder's agent id.

paths.description: REAL. That holder's held paths, sorted.

remaining_ttl.description: REAL. The minimum remaining lease TTL (seconds) across that holder's leases, clamped at 0.

bead_id.description: REAL. A bead id filed as needing a decision, from the committed sidecar, verbatim.

started_id.description: REAL. The bead/task id that started work in a later wave.

open_gate_id.description: REAL. The earliest still-open gate blocking it — only the earliest is reported.
